title: Parker the person: fishing and nights
summary: He tried to get Parker to go fishing; Parker had no time to drown worms.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Was there anything else about Charlie Parker that was important.

Yeah... I used to try to get him to go fishin' but he would never go. I used to kid around. I liked to go fishin', I used to try to get him to go. . . . He'd say "Man, I got no time to drown no worms." . . .
The only time I would see him was at night... I don't know where he was staying.
